label: linux-smoke

machine.display: Xvfb 1600x1000x24 under dbus-run-session, WebKitGTK software rendering (DMA-BUF renderer and compositing off)

notes: One run of scripts/e2e/boot_smoke.py against the release app: cold start = __kelpie.perf.interactiveAt minus app process creation; idle = app + its WebKit processes + kelpied, 30 s with one shell open, percent of one core; RSS = median of the same processes. Not gated: CI prints the current numbers next to these. Shared runners vary, so move this baseline only with a reason, never to hide a regression.
